caption: The drawing depicts a long, gray outer garment, possibly a cloak or coat, with wide, flowing panels and a high collar. The garment features decorative floral trim along the front opening, down the sides, along the edge of the collar, around the hem, and at the cuffs, with additional vertical detailing on the front. There is a fringe embellishment along the edge of the shoulders, cuffs, and the hem. On the right side of the drawing, there is a smaller line sketch of the back view of the same garment, showing similar decorative elements: the floral trim, fringe along the upper back and hem, and the same overall silhouette. The drawing is executed on a beige background, with the garment rendered in shades of gray, and the floral trim details indicated in darker and slightly bluish-gray tones. The paper is taped at the corners with pieces of brown tape.
title: Coat
